reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread under her message in #north-team. I didn't record 25 November, because our records don't back it up:

- The signed 2025-26 renewal order form (signed 21 Nov 2025) puts the end of the current term and the renewal date at 30 November 2026.
- The Brackenwater account page (last updated 30 Sep 2026, owner Marcus Lindqvist) also says the term ends 30 November.
- One CRM note from February 2026 says 31 December 2026, which disagrees with both.

I found nothing that moves the date to 25 November. I asked her whether there's a new amendment or an earlier signing deadline I should look at, and said I'll keep 30 November until she points me to one. The reply covers dates only, no prices or other money terms.
